description: Log caffeinated drinks and see how much caffeine is still in your system using 5.5-hour half-life decay.

faqs.a: Caffeine's half-life averages about 5.5 hours: after that time, half the dose remains; after 11 hours, a quarter.
Espresso ~63 mg, brewed coffee ~95 mg, black tea ~47 mg, green tea ~28 mg, cola ~34 mg, energy drink ~80–160 mg.
faqs.q: How much caffeine is in common drinks?

faqs.a: Enter your usual bedtime and the tool estimates remaining caffeine then — aim for under 50 mg for easier sleep.

howto: Log each caffeinated drink with its time and mg.
See your current estimated caffeine level.
Enter your bedtime to estimate caffeine at sleep time.
Aim for low levels by bed to protect sleep.
title: Caffeine Half-Life Calculator
